mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.6%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in CPIAUCSL signal stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as investors price in both growth slowdown and inflation.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return prediction fails in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 growth < 0) defines a recession regime where S&P 500 returns turn negative over 20 days as market participants anticipate corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chain activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as equity valuations adjust to improved manufacturing conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market prices in reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in PAYEMS and rises in UNRATE signal severe labor market distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as equity valuations discount recessionary employment risks.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return prediction fails in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) defines a regime where S&P 500 returns turn negative over 20 days as investors anticipate aggressive monetary tightening to combat price pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.
